correctness.rationale: Proved the leftmost greedy subsequence embedding criterion Phi(u)=|u|-number_of_even_candidate_runs+indicator(first_letter=1) <=r. Every minimal absent candidate has all odd runs, and if it starts with 0 then its first run has length at least three. Deletion effect and last-run exception yield Phi=r+1, or Phi=r+2 with final run long. Counting all-odd compositions via z/(1-z-z²) yields the three exact Fibonacci layers; r=1 gives {1,000}. An independent exhaustive subsequence algorithm enumerated all binary candidates for each r=1..7, matched exact lengths and counts; this is finite corroboration, with proof for all r from greedy/candidate-run arguments.
